newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Elect, IBM in JV talks.
newsitem.headline: LG Elect, IBM in JV talks.

text.p: LG Electronics Inc of South Korea and International Business Machine Corp of the United States are negotiating to set up a joint venture to produce personal computers, an LG Electronics spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We are in the final stages of concluding the joint venture's capitalisation, stake shares and the name of the company," he said. "Details will be announced later."
He denied a report by the Korea Economic Daily that both companies had agreed to a 50-50 joint venture capitalised at 50 billion won, to be called "LG-IBM".
The daily reported that the joint venture would produce and sell desk-top and notebook personal computers (PCs) on the domestic market.
It said PCs produced by LG Electronics and IBM would be marketed in the domestic market under the LG-IBM brand name.
LG Electronics is South Korea's leading electronics maker and a unit of the LG Group.
